toolSchemas.description: Cut an open interval out of a line border edge, removing exactly lengthMm from every referencing sequence.
Read-only evaluation of the typed constraint set over every interface; returns the constraint diagnostics without mutating the document.
Insert a closed dart on a line border edge, adding exactly 2 * depthMm to every referencing sequence.
Split one edge into two edges at an arc-length offset, replacing it in every referencing sequence.

promptFragment:
kernel capabilities:
- kernel.cut v0.1.0 [experimental]: Cut an open interval out of a line border edge, removing exactly lengthMm from every referencing sequence.
  params: edgeId: string; lengthMm: number; atMm: number (optional); pointAId: string (optional); pointBId: string (optional); edgeIdA: string (optional); edgeIdB: string (optional); maxSeamDeltaMm: number (optional); sample: object{toleranceMm:number, maxSegments:number} (optional)
- kernel.evaluate-constraints v0.1.0 [experimental]: Read-only evaluation of the typed constraint set over every interface; returns the constraint diagnostics without mutating the document.
  params: maxSeamDeltaMm: number (optional); sample: object{toleranceMm:number, maxSegments:number} (optional)
- kernel.insert-dart v0.1.0 [experimental]: Insert a closed dart on a line border edge, adding exactly 2 * depthMm to every referencing sequence.
  params: edgeId: string; depthMm: number; atMm: number (optional); side: enum<left|right> (optional); pointVertexId: string (optional); apexVertexId: string (optional); legInEdgeId: string (optional); legOutEdgeId: string (optional); edgeIdA: string (optional); edgeIdB: string (optional); maxSeamDeltaMm: number (optional); sample: object{toleranceMm:number, maxSegments:number} (optional)
- kernel.split-edge v0.1.0 [experimental]: Split one edge into two edges at an arc-length offset, replacing it in every referencing sequence.
  params: edgeId: string; atMm: number (optional); vertexId: string (optional); edgeIdA: string (optional); edgeIdB: string (optional); maxSeamDeltaMm: number (optional); sample: object{toleranceMm:number, maxSegments:number} (optional)
